name: scaffold-deck
body: Scaffold deck: `init [path]` initializes a deck only where `slides/`, `assets/` and `kalide.yaml` are all absent; with no path it also requires `templates/` to be absent, while with a path an existing local `templates/` is exempt (see cli-init-refuse-existing). With no path it writes the minimal unbranded seed (deck + local `templates/`) from the scaffold's embedded seed; with a path it validates the external library at `path` fail-fast BEFORE writing anything (templates-dir-validation) AND resolves the deck's theme — optional, default `default` (theme-selection) — against it, so an invalid library or a library that does not resolve the deck's theme exits non-zero with a clear error naming the path and writes nothing; it then writes the deck (`slides/`, `assets/`, `kalide.yaml` with `templates: <path>`) and no local `templates/`, leaving an exempt existing local `templates/` in place and inert. Both forms also write the project-root `AGENTS.md` deck-author guide (agent-authoring), verbatim from a static embedded file and inert to the deck.
